title: President Trump Taps Two Democrats in Bipartisan Slate of SEC and CFTC Nominees as Both Agencies Run Short-Handed
summary: Bitcoin Magazine President Trump Taps Two Democrats in Bipartisan Slate of SEC and CFTC Nominees as Both Agencies Run Short-Handed The White House sent four SEC and CFTC nominees to the Senate on Thursday, including former CFTC Commissioner Kristin Johnson and two staffers who worked on the Clarity Act. This post President Trump Taps Two Democrats in Bipartisan Slate of SEC and CFTC Nominees as Both Agencies Run Short-Handed first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
